independent_declaration: The v1 and v2 configs and records stay exactly as committed; nothing here changes how either is read.
purpose: Re-ask the v2 question with the incumbent priced under measurement grouping, with within-group covariance carried by simulated readouts rather than assumed away.
question: Priced with grouping, does an exact-propagation real-time arm still reduce modelled shots by at least 10x against A-CASE at the same accuracy target?

measured_before_freezing.note: Group counts on this experiment's own banks, recorded so the design is auditable. These are inputs, not results.
measured_before_freezing.v2_borrowed_estimate: 7371 -> 913 -> 64 from benchmarks/GROUPING_REDUCTION.md, a different bank on the same molecule; close to the measured values, but an estimate, which this experiment replaces.

h4_chain_110.declared_expectation: Does not admit; the incumbent is expected to be censored.

h2_sto3g.declared_expectation: Reference support is 2; trivially passes and decides nothing.

reference_precondition.rule: Every required instance's reference must be a computational basis state.
reference_precondition.why: The readout simulation in Section 2 factorises over qubits only for a basis state. For a superposition the honest treatment needs the full joint distribution, which this design does not provide.
reference_precondition.verified_value: |11110000> on all three required instances, purity 1.0, one nonzero amplitude

covariance_treatment.rule: Per setting, draw its shot budget of bitstrings from the exact product distribution of the reference in that setting's shared basis; estimate every word in the group as a parity mean of the same draws.
covariance_treatment.carries: true within-group covariance for this reference
covariance_treatment.replaces: the v2 per-word variance bound, which charged each word independently
covariance_treatment.not_applicable_to: real-time arms, whose estimands are overlaps measured by Hadamard tests rather than Pauli expectations on the reference

continuity_check.rule: Under the ungrouped scheme this experiment must reproduce v2's qualifying ordering.
continuity_check.on_disagreement: a defect in this producer, not a finding

setting_model.acase_control: one setting per group of the retained bank's word universe
setting_model.power_krylov_control: one setting per group of the union of supp(H^p)
setting_model.rt_unitary: 2m settings: real and imaginary parts of c(1..m); no grouping, because each (lag, part) is a distinct controlled-evolution circuit with its own ancilla basis
setting_model.rt_hermitian: 2(m-1) settings for c as above, plus m * G_H for d, where G_H is the group count of H's traceless part under the active scheme
setting_model.rt_trotter: 2(m-1) for S plus the full Hermitian pencil priced as d
setting_model.declared_concession: Charging d at m * G_H rather than m * |H| gives the candidate the only grouping any real-time arm receives. It is declared in advance and is deliberate.
setting_model.allocation_rule: A total budget N splits equally across an arm's settings. A bounded ancilla observable then has standard error at most sqrt(settings / N); a sampled group's words inherit the precision of their N / settings shots.

growth.note: Oracle fields null so the incumbent cannot stop on the answer it is compared against.

admission_criterion.rule: For every required instance the incumbent AND at least one exact-propagation real-time arm must reach the target in EXACT arithmetic within their declared caps.
admission_criterion.declared_bias: Keeps instances where the incumbent works, which makes the candidate's job harder.

grid_rule.strict_condition: (U - L) * dt < 2*pi, checked strictly; a violation is INVALID

noise_model.seed_stream_rule: numpy SeedSequence([seed_root, instance_index, scheme_index, sweep_index, cell_index, m, regularizer_index]); shared real-time variates drawn as one (replicas, lags, 2) block from a single advancing generator

cost_model.contract_note: Every basis is frozen by exact arithmetic before noise; adaptive construction and selection are not priced. Unchanged from v2.
cost_model.shots_to_target: the smallest TESTED budget whose median absolute error meets the target; no interpolation; censored when no tested budget qualifies
excluded_from_model: ancilla overhead of a Hadamard test beyond its shot count
cost_model.excluded_note: Excluded for every arm alike. Grouping is no longer excluded; that is the change this experiment makes.

per_mode_floor.rule: absolute per-mode floor in the norm-normalized overlap spectrum

decision_rule.qualifying_comparison: reaches the target AND has modeled shot ratio N_acase / N_rt >= 10, inclusive, on the tested budget grid, under the scheme being evaluated
decision_rule.verdict_scheme_rule: The overall verdict is taken under the LEAST favourable primary scheme for the candidate, so a GO must survive the incumbent's best grouping.

instance_status_order.condition: an exact-propagation real-time arm with a non-ridge regularizer has a qualifying comparison at effective c-component noise >= 1e-5
no PASS, but a qualifying comparison exists at >= 1e-6, including ridge-only
neither above, and a required cost comparison is censored or unpriceable within the grid
otherwise; all comparisons complete but no qualifying candidate at >= 1e-6

decision_rule.combination_rule: all required instances PASS gives GO; all FAIL gives NO_GO; anything else is CONDITIONAL
decision_rule.invalid_combination: If any required instance is INVALID the overall verdict is INVALID.
decision_rule.undetermined_on_required_is_not_a_pass: A censored incumbent cost must never read as a promotion.

prespecified_followup.permitted_on_no_go_or_conditional: exactly one estimator-variance refinement, replacing the flat bounded-ancilla bound with the magnitude-dependent (1 - mu^2)/N
prespecified_followup.publication_rule: the primary verdict is published unchanged alongside any separately labelled refinement; thresholds are never moved after observing results

must_include: decision evaluation under each primary scheme
